channel.title: Homeworld Press
channel.description: Independent editorial coverage of sci-fi literature, technology, space science, and tested buyer's guides.

item.title: Little Red Dots challenge early universe models
item.description: James Webb Space Telescope observations suggest compact, high-redshift objects that may be primordial black holes.

item.title: M John Harrison Breaks the Booker Prize Boundary for Science Fiction
item.description: The selection of The End of Everything forces literary institutions to recognize speculative mechanics.

item.title: NASA Loses Swift After Rescue Attempt Fails in Upper Atmosphere
item.description: A failed docking effort seals the fate of an aging gamma-ray sentinel in low Earth orbit.

item.title: James Webb telescope reveals giant exoplanet through starlight suppression
item.description: Coronagraphic imaging isolates a massive world from its host star's glare.

item.title: Two Percent of the Moon's Mantle Took 150 Gigawatts of Tidal Heat
item.description: A convection model with one low-viscosity layer moves Earth's kneading to the core-mantle boundary, and that relocation is what makes young basalts survivable.

item.title: Two Trapped Ions Let a Gauge Field Decide Whether Matter Moves
item.description: An Oxford group built the smallest loop a lattice gauge theory allows, with matter and field sharing two ions. Flux, not force, stopped the particle.

item.title: A Universe 26.7 Billion Years Old Passes Three Tests and Skips the Deciding One
item.description: A consistency paper drops dark matter and dark energy, then survives nucleosynthesis, 175 rotation curves and cosmic chronometers. The microwave background is still a promise.

item.title: A Drone Sampler Moves Microplastics Measurement Off the Rooftop
item.description: One 25-minute flight at 100 meters over two Colorado sites turned an aerosol instrument into a height-resolved plastic sampler.

item.title: Artemis IV Refueling Plan Enters Its Second Redesign
item.description: NASA's second architecture revision adds a classified number of tanker flights to a depot-to-lander rendezvous in final tanking orbit

item.title: NASA Confronts Orbital Decay to Prolong Hubble Space Telescope Operations
item.description: Atmospheric drag and failing gyroscopes leave mission planners with diminishing mechanical options.
